# Buttons

**`rp-main-button`** = `MainButton` · `@reviewpro/ui-components/MainButton` · Figma: Button · Variant=Filled · no class = `color="primary" size="medium"`

| Class | Code |
|---|---|
| `rp-main-button-secondary` | color="secondary" |

| `rp-main-button-accent-brand` | variant="accentBrand" (RPP70; Generate Insights: its icon is neon, iconColor="neon") |

Text = label prop. A leading .rp-icon = icon prop.

Always set aria-label: it is the only name a screen reader gets.

**`rp-floating-button`** = `FloatingButton` · `@reviewpro/ui-components/FloatingButton` · Figma: FAB

## When to use
| Need | Component |
|------|-----------|
| The main action of a page, tile, dialog or drawer (one per area) | `rp-main-button` (filled) |
| Secondary actions next to it: Cancel, Back, Actions menu | `rp-default-button` (outlined) |
| Low-emphasis actions: toolbar actions, "Add question", inline links that act | `rp-ghost-button` (text) |
| Icon-only actions in tables and toolbars (kebab, edit, close) | `rp-icon-button` + `aria-label` |
| Switching between two to four views of the same data | `rp-toggle-button-group` |
| The one transversal action of a page (create a case, add a note) | `rp-floating-button` |

## Markup
```html
<button type="button" class="rp-main-button rp-main-button-size-small">Save changes</button>
<button type="button" class="rp-main-button rp-main-button-size-small"><span class="rp-icon rp-icon-add"></span><span>Add user</span></button>
<button type="button" class="rp-main-button rp-main-button-size-small rp-main-button-danger">Delete user</button>
<button type="button" class="rp-default-button rp-default-button-size-small">Cancel</button>
<button type="button" class="rp-default-button rp-default-button-size-small rp-default-button-primary">Change photo</button>
<button type="button" class="rp-ghost-button"><span class="rp-icon rp-icon-filter"></span><span>Filters</span></button>
<button type="button" class="rp-icon-button" data-rp-menu="rowMenu" aria-label="More actions"><span class="rp-icon rp-icon-actions"></span></button>
<div class="rp-toggle-button-group" role="group" aria-label="Show">
  <button type="button" class="rp-toggle-button rp-toggle-button-selected" aria-pressed="true">Volume</button>
  <button type="button" class="rp-toggle-button" aria-pressed="false">Rating</button>
</div>
```

## Floating button (FAB)
One per page at most, for the page's transversal action. It opens its actions as a menu (`children` in code):
```html
<button type="button" class="rp-floating-button" data-rp-menu="fabMenu" aria-label="Create" data-rp-tooltip="Create" data-rp-tooltip-placement="left"><span class="rp-icon rp-icon-add"></span></button>
<div class="rp-menu" id="fabMenu" role="menu" aria-label="Create" data-rp-align-right>…</div>
```

## Sizes
- `MainButton` and `DefaultButton` default to **medium (48px)**. Inside tiles, tables, toolbars, dialogs and drawers use **small (40px)**: add `-size-small`.
- `GhostButton` defaults to **small (40px)**; `rp-ghost-button-size-medium` is 48px.
- `rp-icon-button` is 32px (Figma IconButton), `rp-icon-button-size-small` 24px (IconButton_Squared).

## Behavior (shared.js)
- `data-rp-open="id"` opens a dialog or drawer, `data-rp-menu="id"` a menu, `data-rp-snackbar="Text"` shows a snackbar, `data-rp-validate="Text"` checks required fields first.
- Toggle buttons in a group are exclusive (add `data-rp-multiple` to the group for several).

## Rules
- One `rp-main-button` per area. The action order is Cancel (default) then the main action on the right.
- Labels: a verb or verb + noun, sentence case, specific ("Delete user", not "OK"). Cancel is always "Cancel".
- An icon goes before the text, only for well-known actions (Add, Filters, Export, Download). Never on the main action of a dialog.
- Destructive actions use `-danger` and open a confirmation dialog first.
- No shadows on buttons.

## MainButton variants
`variant="accent"` = `rp-main-button-accent` (Energetic Green, dark label), `variant="tertiary"` = `rp-main-button-tertiary` (Midnight), `variant="accentBrand"` = `rp-main-button-accent-brand` (RPP70). The AI call to action (Generate Insights) is `rp-main-button rp-main-button-accent-brand rp-main-button-size-small` with an `rp-icon-ai` icon, drawn in neon.
